subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple has a wall that Kelno reached over to recruit people from the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Kelno had been recruiting, busily, badly, reaching over the Earth Temple's wall and peeling people off one frightened bugbear at a time.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple contains a secret door that coughed up three gnolls.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple has a corridor where the gnolls spilled out and the battle occurred.
source_quote: spilling out into the corridor with the indignation of creditors.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple has a corridor with brown-and-black walls.
source_quote: quiet in that ugly brown-and-black corridor

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple has a secret door that hung open after the gnolls were killed.

subject: Sequoia

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia has been getting funnier the deeper into the temple the group goes.
source_quote: He has been getting funnier the deeper into this place we go.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren stepped up with his two mercenaries and put his hands on Calmer.
source_quote: Then Dren stepped up with his two mercenaries and put his hands on Calmer.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric who bellowed, 'Unhand me, you creatures!'
source_quote: "Unhand me, you creatures!" Bellowed, full-throated, the over-eager zealot's outrage at being denied a fight he had no business standing in.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer had three hit points and was drained of healing resources.
source_quote: he could not patch himself past the thin margin he was running on.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was dragged back up the corridor by Dren.
source_quote: Dren dragged him back up the corridor, all protest and no leverage.

subject: Zinnia

subject: bugbear
fact: A bugbear was killed and had been a purchased defection from the gnolls.

subject: gnoll
fact: Three gnolls emerged from the secret door, hunched and reeking.
source_quote: Three gnolls, hunched and reeking, spilling out into the corridor

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll exclaimed, 'Tiefling flesh!' and expressed delight at the prospect of eating it.
source_quote: "Tiefling flesh!" it howled, delighted, like a man discovering a delicacy he'd thought extinct.

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll said, 'We paid good money for that!'
source_quote: "We paid good money for that!" one of them snarled

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll said, 'Now we will get our money, and get food!'
source_quote: "Now we will get our money, and get food!"

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll was killed by a dagger strike under the ribs.

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll was killed by Sequoia after being tagged clean.
source_quote: Sequoia took the second. Stepped in, tagged it clean, opened it up.

subject: gnoll
fact: One gnoll was killed by a third dagger strike from the blind side.

subject: coins
fact: The narrator pocketed coins that had the wrong stamp on them.
source_quote: gold with the wrong stamp on it, in the hands of a man who used to guard our wall. I pocketed the coins.

subject: coins
fact: The coins were considered both evidence and payment.
source_quote: Evidence and payment both.

subject: Air Temple gnolls

source_quote: We paid good money for that!

subject: Air Temple gnolls
fact: The Air Temple gnolls viewed the bugbear as a purchased investment.

subject: killing first gnoll
fact: The first gnoll was killed by a dagger strike under the ribs, followed by Zinnia finishing it.
source_quote: the dagger went where daggers go. Thud. Steel through the soft place under the ribs, the full weight of the ambush behind it, and the thing folded most of the way to dead in a single beat. Zinnia drifted in and finished what I'd left twitching.

subject: second gnoll's attack
fact: The second gnoll scratched the narrator across the side but did not land a lethal blow.
source_quote: Caught me across the side, hard enough to register, not hard enough to mean anything.

subject: killing second gnoll
fact: Sequoia killed the second gnoll by tagging it clean and opening it up.
source_quote: Sequoia took the second. Stepped in, tagged it clean, opened it up.

fact: Dren dragged Calmer back up the corridor against his protest.
source_quote: Dren dragged him back up the corridor, all protest and no leverage.

subject: decision to recon
fact: The group decided the next action would be a recon mission, not an assault.
source_quote: Not an assault. Not yet. 'Recon mission.'

subject: recruitment by purchase
fact: Loyalty in the temple lasts only as long as the coin is warm.
source_quote: everyone in this temple was buying everyone else, and the loyalty lasted exactly as long as the coin was warm.

subject: tiefling prejudice
fact: The narrator has been threatened for being a tiefling by a dryad, a gnome guard, and now a gnoll.
source_quote: A dryad once asked if I'd crawled out of the Abyss to torment her; a gnome guard once asked *or whatever you are*; and now a starving Air Temple dog wanted me on a spit.

subject: secret door to water temple
fact: The narrator questioned whether the secret door led to the Water Temple.
source_quote: "This leads to the water temple?" I said, already counting what might be behind it.

subject: secret door
fact: The secret door led from the Air Temple corridor to an unknown area.
source_quote: the secret door hung open on whatever the gnolls had crawled out of.
